protocol: One alternative only: for pre-GLM lower-confidence quarter rows and their pre-GLM top four classes, replace each quartet's population standard deviation in the existing ATLAS conditional blend with max(its own sd, the median sd of selected quartets in that inference batch, 1e-9). Keep zero-variance quartets unchanged. Keep ATLAS weight 0.1, quartet probability mass, order, GLM selection and temperature, projection, and final style treatment fixed between the two arms. For official Qwen8 OOF the batch is a single held-out prompt fold; for the external cohorts it is the cohort and projection. Prespecified evidence threshold for further testing: require nonnegative paired style balanced-accuracy change on all three official OOF conditions plus both external 1360 projections and the true minimum-50 216-row cohort, a positive change on at least one official and one external condition, and an external paired 95% interval excluding zero on the positive side for at least one of those external conditions. The 54-row and forced-15% outcomes are descriptive. Run once; no alternate floors, projections or cohort-weighted pooled headline. Report mean accuracy, paired corrections and harms, shifts by group and empirical confidence intervals. No competition submission.
intervals: Official: 4000 paired bootstrap draws over 150 prompt clusters, seed 92620. External: 3000 paired draws among unique prompts within observed true class, seed 19112026. Percentile 95%.
scope: Official aligned per-row OOF components use different native five-fold partitions; no end-to-end independent leaderboard. 1360 rows/12 observed classes have proxy upstream model labels, two Terra rows and no GLM stage. Among 270 small-cohort rows, 205 exact texts and all prompt fingerprints occur in known V30 supervised sources. Small fixed and adaptive projections match bit-for-bit and do not constitute independent replications.
